Around [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], a small, uninhabited '''planetoid''' in the [[Mustafar system/Legends|Mustafar system]] was destroyed during a test of the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Conqueror (superlaser)|''Conqueror'']]{{'s}} [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]]. The [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid's]] destruction was recorded and sent to an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Weapon Research Facility|research facility]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].
